"""Michigan Compiled Laws: every chapter object on /Laws/ChapterIndex, read whole from /Home/RenderDoc; one section per sectionWrapper box (block_texts), pending '.new' texts skipped."""
import re
B = "https://www.legislature.mi.gov"
HEAD = re.compile(r"^(\d+[a-z]?\.\d+[a-z]*(?:\.[a-z]+)?(?:,\s*\d+[a-z]?\.\d+[a-z]*)*)\s+(.*)$")

def sections():
    kind, index = fetch(B + "/Laws/ChapterIndex")
    objs = []
    for o in re.findall(r'href="/Home/GetObject\?objectName=(mcl-chap\d+[a-z]?)"', index):
        if o not in objs:
            objs.append(o)
    log("chapters: %d" % len(objs))
    for obj in objs:
        url = B + "/Home/RenderDoc?objectName=" + obj
        kind, body = fetch(url)
        n = skipped = 0
        for box in block_texts(body, cls="sectionWrapper"):
            lines = box.split("\n")
            k = next((i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if HEAD.match(l)), None)
            if k is None:
                continue
            sids, heading = HEAD.match(lines[k]).groups()
            if ".new" in sids or re.search(r"\.\d+[a-z]*\.[a-z]", sids):
                skipped += 1          # 2.13.new: a text not yet in force
                continue
            heading = heading.strip()
            text = "\n".join(lines[k + 1:]).strip() or heading      # "2.208 Repealed. 2018, Act 321 ..." is the whole entry
            for sid in re.split(r",\s*", sids):                    # "2.104, 2.105 Repealed. ..." disposes of both
                n += 1
                yield {"id": sid, "heading": heading, "text": text, "url": url + "#" + sid}
        log("%s: %d sections%s" % (obj, n, " (%d pending texts skipped)" % skipped if skipped else ""))
